strategy.mission: To democratize business process automation by giving every small business owner the tools, clarity, and confidence to reclaim their time and scale smarter.
strategy.positioning: The go-to automation platform purpose-built for small businesses - making enterprise-grade process automation accessible, affordable, and actionable without requiring technical expertise.
strategy.value_proposition: We give small business owners and operators the power to automate their most time-consuming processes so they can focus on growth, not grunt work - no developers or IT team required.
strategy.vision: A world where no small business is held back by manual, repetitive work - where automation is a competitive advantage available to everyone, not just the enterprise.

color-brand-accent.$description: Primary CTAs, active states, links, key data highlights

color-brand-secondary.$description: Body backgrounds, card surfaces, content containers

color-status-success.$description: Success states, completed workflow indicators, uptime signals

color-surface-mid.$description: Borders, dividers, table lines, secondary surfaces

imagery: Clean, abstract visualisations of flow: connected nodes, process paths, pipeline diagrams — rendered in brand palette
UI screenshots at full resolution showing clear, organised dashboards
Flat-lay product metaphors: clean desk, single device, minimal clutter — high contrast lighting
Black and white photography with a single teal accent element composited in
Avoid warm-toned lifestyle imagery — this palette reads cold next to earth tones
Outline icon style: 1.5px stroke, sharp corners with 2px radius only
24px and 16px grid variants required for UI and marketing respectively
Flow-specific metaphors: branching arrows, toggle switches, looping arrows, plug/socket for integrations
Teal used as the single accent color for interactive or highlighted icons
Icon grid must be mathematically consistent — no optical sizing adjustments
Hard rectangles with 4–6px border radius maximum — precision over friendliness
Thin 1px rules used as section dividers rather than padding alone
Pill shapes reserved exclusively for status badges and tags
No organic or blob shapes — discipline of form is part of the brand message
Thin-bordered cards with a 1px Slate Rule border rather than drop shadows
Fine 1px grid lines at 3% opacity as hero background texture — references the idea of structured workflow
No paper or organic textures — counter to the precision positioning
Subtle linear gradient on CTA buttons: teal to a 15% lighter teal — adds depth without breaking flat-design discipline
Dark sections use a near-invisible 2% noise overlay to prevent pure black flatness
layout_notes: Strong grid structure: 12-column desktop, 4-column mobile, 8px base unit
Section backgrounds alternate between Signal White and a 4% tint of Graphite Core
Full-bleed dark hero section with teal accent headline word or underline
Data and feature sections use card grids with consistent column alignment
Process step visualisations shown as horizontal numbered flows on desktop, vertical on mobile
Base unit: 8px strict grid
Section vertical padding: 80px desktop, 48px mobile
Card internal padding: 24px all sides
Headline to subheadline gap: 12px
Component group spacing: 32px; between sections: 96px desktop
Transitions: 150–250ms ease-in-out — snappy, not sluggish
Counter animations on key metrics when they enter viewport — reinforces data and reliability
Workflow diagram animations: nodes connect sequentially left-to-right, 300ms per step
Hover on cards: border color transitions from Slate Rule to Electric Teal at 200ms
No bounce or spring physics — linear or ease curves only; precision implies control
WCAG AA compliance mandatory; WCAG AAA target for all body text
Electric Teal (#06B6D4) on white (#F9FAFB) — verify contrast ratio; use darker teal variant (#0891B2) if failing 4.5:1
Focus ring: 2px solid Electric Teal, 2px offset, visible on both light and dark backgrounds
All data visualisations must include text equivalents or accessible data tables
Icon-only UI elements require aria-label; status colors always paired with text labels
Warm amber, orange, or brown tones — incompatible with the precision palette
Decorative gradients across backgrounds — use only on interactive elements
Heavy drop shadows — use borders instead to maintain disciplined geometry
Rounded corners above 6px — softens the precision signal
Any imagery showing overwhelmed or stressed operators — counter to empowerment values
Overcrowded layouts — white space is structural in this direction, not decorative
visualDirection.name: Precision Flow
visualDirection.rationale:
A crisp, high-contrast system identity that communicates capability and reliability through disciplined geometry, clear typographic hierarchy, and a restrained color palette. Confidence through order — this platform runs like clockwork.

Some small business owners — particularly those who've been burned by unreliable tools — respond to visual signals of precision and dependability over warmth. This direction uses high contrast, tight grids, and deliberate use of a single electric accent to communicate that the product is serious, dependable, and genuinely powerful without feeling out of reach.
